confirm.privacy: [privacy] This request and proposal were sent to {0} (cloud LLM).
error.interactive_non_tty: Interactive confirmation (-i) needs a terminal. In non-TTY contexts only whitelisted read-only diagnostics run; everything else is shown for manual execution.
error.llm.config: missing LLM API key. Set DAEDALUS_LLM_API_KEY or configure ~/.config/daedalus/copilot.json
error.llm.timeout: LLM request to {0} did not respond within {1}s. Try again, or set DAEDALUS_LLM_TIMEOUT_MS to a higher value (current default: 30).
risk.banner.caution: ⚠ This command modifies system state — review carefully, then execute manually
risk.banner.safe: ✓ Low-risk suggestion — run it in your terminal
risk.manual_hint: Please run this command in your terminal (commands outside the sandbox whitelist are shown, never executed by this advisor).
risk.pattern.chmod_777: Permissions fully open; violates least privilege
risk.pattern.curl_pipe_shell: Download-and-execute from network; classic supply-chain attack surface
risk.pattern.dd_block: Direct block-device write; wipes target disk
risk.pattern.etc_overwrite: Overwrites critical system files; may corrupt the system
risk.pattern.eval_network: Executes network-downloaded code of unverified origin
risk.pattern.iptables_flush: Flushes firewall rules; exposes network attack surface
risk.reason.outside_sandbox: Not in the sandbox diagnostics whitelist — shown only
help.banner: Daedalus OS Copilot - AI-Native Command Assistant
help.default_behavior: Default: every proposal is shown with its risk tier before anything happens. In a terminal, only whitelisted read-only diagnostics run after your y/n; everything else is display-only for you to run manually. In pipes/scripts, whitelisted read-only diagnostics run directly. All decisions are audit-logged.
help.flag.verbose: -v, --verbose         Toggle: hide translated-command preview (default: shown before execute)
help.flag.interactive: -i, --interactive     Force y/n confirmation (already the default in a terminal; kept for compatibility)
help.flag.yes: -y, --yes             Run whitelisted read-only diagnostics without the y/n prompt (for CI / pipes)
help.flag.dry_run: --dry-run             Show command that would be executed, but do NOT run it
